summary: Iteration 10 review — Assemble-team, /api/employers, admin permission scopes, staff CRUD, support console, and customization. Both backend (12/12 pytest) and frontend flows for Projects, TalentDashboard, and Admin (super + support) pass end-to-end.

issues: All 12 employer cards seeded with placeholder name 'Test Employer' and blank industry ('—'). Talents can't visually differentiate companies. Suggest seeding meaningful company_name and company_industry, or hiding cards missing company_name.

React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by Emergent's dev instrumentation injecting <span> inside <select><option>. Cosmetic only, but pollutes console — consider suppressing markers on option children.

action_items: (Optional) Improve seed data for employers so talent-facing 'Companies on Job Atlas' cards show real company_name + company_industry instead of 'Test Employer / —'.
(Optional) Ensure ve-source instrumentation doesn't inject <span> children inside <option> elements to silence React hydration warnings on Projects.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2664 lines and still growing — continue extracting resource modules (projects, employers, talent) into /app/backend/routes/ like admin.py to keep files <700 lines.
admin.py PUT /admin/customization uses Dict[str, Any] with a hardcoded allow-list. Consider a Pydantic model with Optional fields for schema validation + OpenAPI docs.
In admin.py _sanitize_scopes drops unknown scopes silently — could log/reject at API layer so misconfigured clients aren't silently ignored.
GET /api/employers doesn't paginate (to_list(300)). Add limit/offset before the platform gets >300 companies.
GET /api/employers exposes 'name' (may be personal name if company_name absent) — consider always returning company_name only or masking name.
ProjectLeadIn accepts assigned_team without any auth — anyone can submit unlimited leads. Add simple rate limiting / captcha for anti-abuse.

All pass in 5-6s. Frontend UI verified via Playwright — screenshots at /app/test_reports/{projects_modal,talent_dash,admin_super,admin_support}.png.
